microtheory.name: geography
microtheory.definition: Geography — spatial study of Earth + human relationship to it. Physical geography (landforms, climate, biomes, hydrology, soils), human geography (population, urban, economic, cultural, political), GIS + cartography + remote sensing, regional + topical. Humboldt, Ritter, Sauer, Hartshorne, Harvey. Substrate analogue: the discipline of spatial pattern + spatial process — where things are + why.

concepts.name: geography_definition
concepts.definition: Study of Earth's surface — physical features + human activities + their interrelationships. Humboldt + Ritter 19th c founders.

concepts.name: physical_geography
concepts.definition: Natural environment. Landforms, climate, biomes, hydrology, soils, biogeography.

concepts.name: human_geography
concepts.definition: Human spatial patterns. Population, urban, economic, cultural, political, historical.

concepts.name: regional_geography
concepts.definition: Integrated study of particular places. Counters topical fragmentation. Hartshorne emphasised.

concepts.name: space_place
concepts.definition: Tuan. Space = abstract location; place = lived meaningful location. Phenomenology of place.

concepts.name: scale_geographic
concepts.definition: Local → regional → national → global. Patterns at one scale may not hold at another. Ecological fallacy.

concepts.name: spatial_diffusion
concepts.definition: Hägerstrand. Innovations + diseases + cultures spread through space + time. Contagious vs hierarchical diffusion.

concepts.name: core_periphery
concepts.definition: Wallerstein. World-system: core (developed), semi-periphery, periphery (developing). Spatial structure of capitalism.

concepts.name: first_law_geography
concepts.definition: Tobler 1970. 'Everything is related to everything else, but near things are more related than distant things.' Spatial autocorrelation.

concepts.name: landform
concepts.definition: Geomorphological features. Mountains, plains, plateaus, valleys, deserts, coasts.

concepts.name: biome
concepts.definition: Major ecological community. Tropical rainforest, temperate forest, tundra, taiga, grassland, desert, marine, freshwater.

concepts.name: hydrology
concepts.definition: Water on + below Earth's surface. River systems, watersheds, aquifers, glaciers, oceans.

concepts.name: köppen_climate_classification
concepts.definition: Wladimir Köppen 1884. Climate zones by temperature + precipitation. A (tropical) B (arid) C (temperate) D (continental) E (polar) + subdivisions.

concepts.name: watershed
concepts.definition: Area drained by river system. Basic hydrological + ecological unit. Substrate analogue: substrate's catchment-domain.

concepts.name: cartography
concepts.definition: Map-making. Map projections, scale, symbolisation, generalisation. Tension: all maps distort.

concepts.name: map_projection
concepts.definition: 2D representation of 3D sphere. Mercator (conformal), Robinson (compromise), Peters (equal-area). Each distorts something.

concepts.name: gis
concepts.definition: Geographic Information System. Spatial data layers + analysis. ESRI ArcGIS, QGIS. Revolutionised geography since 1990s.

concepts.name: remote_sensing
concepts.definition: Satellite + aerial imaging. Landsat, MODIS, Sentinel. Multispectral, radar, LIDAR.

concepts.name: spatial_analysis
concepts.definition: Statistics of spatial data. Spatial autocorrelation (Moran's I), kriging, point pattern analysis.

concepts.name: thematic_map
concepts.definition: Specific subject — choropleth, dot, isarithmic, cartogram. Distinct from reference (topographic, road).

concepts.name: urban_geography
concepts.definition: Cities + urbanisation. Site + situation. Central place theory (Christaller). Urban morphology + structure.

concepts.name: central_place_theory
concepts.definition: Christaller 1933. Settlements form hierarchy of central places serving surrounding hinterlands. Hexagonal market areas.

concepts.name: population_geography
concepts.definition: Distribution + density + demographic dynamics. Demographic transition. Migration. Aging populations.

concepts.name: economic_geography
concepts.definition: Spatial economic activity. Krugman's new economic geography. Industrial clusters (Porter). Globalisation of production.

concepts.name: agglomeration_economies
concepts.definition: Productivity gains from spatial concentration. Sharing + matching + learning. Silicon Valley, Wall Street.

concepts.name: cultural_geography
concepts.definition: Cultural patterns + diffusion + landscapes. Sauer. Modern: identity + meaning + power.

concepts.name: political_geography
concepts.definition: Spatial dimensions of political phenomena. States + borders + electoral geography + geopolitics.

concepts.name: geopolitics
concepts.definition: Geography + power + state strategy. Mackinder's heartland, Spykman's rimland. Critical revivals.

concepts.name: demographic_transition
concepts.definition: Five stages. High birth + death → declining death → declining birth → low both → potential post-transition. Most countries somewhere on curve.

concepts.name: urbanisation
concepts.definition: Increasing share of population in cities. Over 50% globally since 2007. Megacities (>10M) proliferating.

concepts.name: migration_human
concepts.definition: Movement between places. Push + pull. Voluntary + forced. Internal + international.

concepts.name: globalisation_geography
concepts.definition: Compression of space-time. Castells's space of flows. Friedman's flat world critique.

concepts.name: world_systems_theory
concepts.definition: Wallerstein. Capitalist world-economy as integrated unit with core, semi-periphery, periphery.

concepts.name: time_space_compression
concepts.definition: Harvey. Capitalism reduces relative distances through technology + organisation. Acceleration.

concepts.name: environmental_geography
concepts.definition: Human-environment interaction. Hazards + risks + sustainability + conservation. Substrate analogue: substrate-environment coupling.

concepts.name: anthropocene_geography
concepts.definition: Human-dominated geological epoch. Global ecological footprint exceeds planetary boundaries.

rules.name: toblers_first_law_governs_spatial_relations
rules.head: Jabberwock analyses spatial pattern
rules.body: near things are more related than distant. Spatial autocorrelation. Geographical analysis must account for. Tobler 1970.

rules.name: scale_matters_for_spatial_inference
rules.head: Jabberwock infers from spatial data
rules.body: patterns at one scale may not hold at another. Ecological fallacy + modifiable areal unit problem. Substrate's scale-aware inference.

rules.name: agglomeration_creates_positive_returns
rules.head: Jabberwock studies economic location
rules.body: spatial concentration produces sharing + matching + learning externalities. Self-reinforcing. Krugman + Porter.

rules.name: every_map_distorts
rules.head: Jabberwock represents Earth on flat surface
rules.body: no projection preserves shape + area + distance + direction simultaneously. Choose projection for purpose. Mercator distorts area.

rules.name: place_is_constituted_through_meaning
rules.head: Jabberwock examines a location's significance
rules.body: place ≠ space. Place is space invested with meaning through dwelling + practice + memory. Tuan's phenomenology. Substrate's lived-vs-objective location.
